title: Canonical completed constant base map and constant complex functor
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $I\subset A$ an ideal. Write $A_X$ for the constant ring sheaf and $B_X=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(A/I^n)_X$, with the quotient transition maps, using the constant and completed coefficient constructions of [def-weil-pbc-adic-lisse-module]. Define $c_{X,I}:A_X\to B_X$ to be the canonical ring-sheaf homomorphism whose composite with the projection to $(A/I^n)_X$ is the constant sheaf map induced by $A\to A/I^n$, for every $n\geq1$. For an $A$-module cochain complex $P^\bullet$, define its termwise constant $A_X$-module complex $\underline{P^\bullet}_X$ [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] by $(\underline{P^\bullet}_X)^q=\underline{P^q}_X$ and $d^q=\underline{d_P^q}_X$. A chain map is sent to its termwise constant sheaf map; this defines the constant-complex functor from cochain complexes of $A$-modules to cochain complexes of $A_X$-modules. No Noetherian, finiteness, completeness or boundedness hypothesis is part of either construction.
